verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents pre-built, brandable UI components (Elements for recipient bank details, Checkout, Vault) with customizable design to match branding, plus wallet/payout APIs and SDKs for balances and payouts (mangopay-docs-29, -30, -31, -5, -33). However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated white-label transaction-history component, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of how deeply branding can be customized. Missing for 10: explicit transaction-history embeddable UI, independent developer corroboration of white-labeling depth.
